facts.text: The Fresno State Winery engages students in the winemaking profession at the nation's first and largest commercial winery on a college campus.

sources.title: Fresno State Winery - Fresno State Winery
sources.quote: At the Fresno State Winery we strive to engage our students in all aspects of the winemaking profession at the nation's first and largest commercial winery on a college campus.
